name: Improved Hammer Throw
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Improved Hammer Throw (Combat)
Source Heroes from the Fringe pg. 9
Your ability to knock down your foes with ranged attacks is impressive.

Prerequisites: Int 13, Combat Expertise, Hammer Throw, Improved Trip, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, base attack bonus +6, dwarf.

Benefit: You can use the Hammer Throw feat against targets at any range and of any size.
